Session.TurnNeverDecreases.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			(before._tag !== "Idle" && before._tag !== "Running") ||
			(after._tag !== "Idle" && after._tag !== "Running") ||
			after.turn >= before.turn

Session.TurnAdvancesByAtMostOne.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			(before._tag !== "Idle" && before._tag !== "Running") ||
			(after._tag !== "Idle" && after._tag !== "Running") ||
			after.turn <= before.turn + 1

Session.ModelRequestsStartedNeverDecreas.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			after.turn !== before.turn ||
			after.model_requests_started >= before.model_requests_started

Session.ModelRequestsStartedGrowsByAtMos.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			after.turn !== before.turn ||
			after.model_requests_started <= before.model_requests_started + 1

Session.PendingUserMessagesGrowsByAtMost.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			after.turn !== before.turn ||
			after.pending_user_messages <= before.pending_user_messages + 1

Session.OnlySendUserMessageAddsPendingMe.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			after.turn !== before.turn ||
			after.pending_user_messages <= before.pending_user_messages ||
			command._tag === "SendUserMessage"

Session.OnlyArchiveSessionSetsArchivedFl.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			after._tag !== "Terminated" ||
			!after.archived ||
			(before._tag === "Terminated" && before.archived) ||
			command._tag === "ArchiveSession"

Session.IdleSessionStartsTheNextTurn.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before._tag !== "Idle" || after._tag !== "Running" || after.turn === before.turn + 1

Session.StatusRunningCarriesStartedTurn.source:
({ after, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event._tag !== "session.status_running" ||
					(after._tag === "Running" && event.turn === after.turn),
			)

Session.StatusIdleCarriesEndedTurn.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event._tag !== "session.status_idle" ||
					(before._tag === "Running" &&
						event.turn === before.turn &&
						(after._tag === "Idle" || after._tag === "Running")),
			)

Session.AbandonedTurnEnds.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event._tag !== "turn.abandoned" ||
					(before._tag === "Running" &&
						event.turn === before.turn &&
						(after._tag === "Idle" ||
							(after._tag === "Running" && after.turn === before.turn + 1))),
			)

Session.AgentMessageEndsTheTurn.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event._tag !== "agent.message" ||
					(before._tag === "Running" &&
						(after._tag === "Idle" ||
							(after._tag === "Running" && after.turn === before.turn + 1))),
			)

Session.OnlyAPauseMakesATurnWait.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			!after.paused ||
			(before._tag === "Running" && before.turn === after.turn && before.paused) ||
			events.some((event) => event._tag === "turn.awaiting")

Session.APauseKeepsTheTurn.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event._tag !== "turn.awaiting" ||
					(before._tag === "Running" &&
						after._tag === "Running" &&
						after.turn === before.turn &&
						after.paused),
			)

Session.AContinuationKeepsTheTurn.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event._tag !== "turn.continued" ||
					(before._tag === "Running" &&
						after._tag === "Running" &&
						after.turn === before.turn &&
						!after.paused),
			)

Session.APausedTurnGoesOnOnceAnswered.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			!before.paused ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			after.turn !== before.turn ||
			after.awaiting_calls >= 1 ||
			(!after.paused && events.some((event) => event._tag === "turn.continued"))

Session.AnInterruptEndsAPausedTurn.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			!before.paused ||
			command._tag !== "SendUserInterrupt" ||
			after._tag === "Idle" ||
			(after._tag === "Running" && after.turn === before.turn + 1)

ToolConfirmation.ASettledCallNeverChange.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status === "",
				before.status === "pending",
				[
					after.status === before.status,
					after.deny_message === before.deny_message,
					after.result_text === before.result_text,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

ToolConfirmation.ACallKeepsItsSessionTur.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status === "",
				[
					after.session_id === before.session_id,
					after.tool_use_id === before.tool_use_id,
					after.turn === before.turn,
					after.awaits === before.awaits,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

ToolConfirmation.ACallIsAnsweredWithWhat.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before.status === after.status ||
			after.status === "pending" ||
			(((after.status !== "allowed" && after.status !== "denied") ||
				before.awaits === "confirmation") &&
				(after.status !== "returned" || before.awaits === "result"))

RequestToolAction.ARequestWaitsInItsOwnT.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before.call.status !== "" ||
			after.call.status === "" ||
			(before.session._tag === "Running" &&
				after.session._tag === "Running" &&
				after.call.turn === before.session.turn &&
				after.session.awaiting_calls === before.session.awaiting_calls + 1)

ConfirmTool.OnlyAPendingCallOfTheRunning.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before.call.status === "pending" &&
			before.call.awaits === "confirmation" &&
			before.session._tag === "Running" &&
			before.call.turn === before.session.turn &&
			(after.call.status === "allowed" || after.call.status === "denied")

ReturnCustomToolResult.OnlyAPendingCallO.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before.call.status === "pending" &&
			before.call.awaits === "result" &&
			before.session._tag === "Running" &&
			before.call.turn === before.session.turn &&
			after.call.status === "returned"

Session.AnInterruptedTurnNeitherWaitsNor.source:
({ before, events }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			!before.interrupted ||
			events.every((event) => event._tag !== "turn.awaiting" && event._tag !== "turn.continued")

Session.AnInterruptedTurnStaysInterrupte.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			!before.interrupted ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			after.turn !== before.turn ||
			after.interrupted

Session.ADeadlineAbandonsOnlyItsOwnSegme.source:
({ before, command, events }) =>
			command._tag !== "AbandonTurn" ||
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			events.length === 0 ||
			(command.segment ?? 1) ===
				(before.open_model_request_id === null && !before.paused
					? before.model_requests_started + 1
					: before.model_requests_started)

Session.AnEndedTurnStartsTheQueuedOne.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			before.pending_user_messages === 0 ||
			after._tag !== "Idle" ||
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event._tag !== "session.status_idle" ||
					(event.stop_reason.type !== "end_turn" &&
						event.stop_reason.type !== "retries_exhausted" &&
						event.stop_reason.type !== "interrupted"),
			)

Session.AStopNamesTheUnansweredCalls.source:
({ before, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					(event._tag !== "session.status_idle" && event._tag !== "session.status_terminated") ||
					event.event_ids === (before._tag === "Running" ? before.awaiting_ids : NO_TOOL_USE_IDS),
			)

Session.SystemContextIsBounded.source:
(s) =>
			(s._tag !== "Idle" && s._tag !== "Running") ||
			s.system_context_length === undefined ||
			s.system_context_length <= MAX_AGENT_SYSTEM_LENGTH,
		ModelRequestsStartedNonNegative: (s) => s._tag !== "Running" || s.model_requests_started >= 0
